principle: A gap is closed only by a theorem, exact finite disposition, prospective empirical result, or explicit parent-sufficient/boundary terminal. Documents alone do not close empirical gaps.

gaps.question: Has the relevant parent space been searched enough to propose a basis without obvious wheel reinvention?
Is there one unique fundamental cognitive atom?
gaps.evidence: Static Boolean calibration shows multiple minimal generating bases; exact adaptive calibration shows algebraic minimality differs from resource optimality.
gaps.next: Stage C-v1 structured basis census and mutual bounded compilation among candidate bases.

gaps.question: Does local adaptive transducer basis reduce to ordinary state-machine/coalgebra form?
gaps.next: Compile Stage C-v1 candidates to canonical Moore/Mealy/coalgebraic parents with resource accounting.

gaps.question: Can the basis avoid hiding an arbitrary interpreter/update kernel?
gaps.next: Enforce restricted Stage C-v1 grammar; universal interpreter and arbitrary UPDATE are forbidden.

gaps.question: Is current behavior enough to define a morphology?
gaps.next: Formalize scalable developmental preorder/equivalence with resource/tolerance composition.

gaps.question: Does the smallest primitive basis minimize practical developmental cost?
gaps.evidence: Adaptive Boolean census: richer complete bases can have lower mean/max compilation depth than inclusion-minimal bases.
gaps.next: Repeat with structured Stage C-v1 resource vectors, not Boolean depth only.

Can the same basis derive probabilistic update/inference, or is explicit stochastic structure resource-irreducible?

gaps.next: Stage D programmatic micro-derivation with description/execution/search costs.

gaps.question: Are neural/symbolic/probabilistic/programmatic the only relevant known forms?
gaps.evidence: MORPHOLOGY_ATLAS_V1 adds state/dynamical, neuromorphic, reservoir, cellular/developmental, HDC/VSA, cognitive architecture, memory-centric, evolutionary and integration/hybrid families.
gaps.next: Use atlas for parent reduction; do not treat historical labels as final equivalence classes.

gaps.next: Exact finite frontier calibration under Stage E.

gaps.evidence: Linear lifecycle toy gives exact reuse-horizon/revision crossover; no empirical architecture claim.
gaps.next: Exact finite morphology frontier with at least two ecology axes, then prospective larger-domain prediction.

gaps.next: Prospective phase studies with adaptive neural parents, not frozen strawmen.
